verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 8.81
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 8.81

verses.pali: 9. Sativagga
verses.english: 9. Mindfulness

verses.pali: Satisampajaññasutta
verses.english: Mindfulness and Situational Awareness

verses.pali: “Satisampajaññe, bhikkhave, asati satisampajaññavipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti hirottappaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when there is no mindfulness and situational awareness, one who lacks mindfulness and situational awareness has destroyed a vital condition for conscience and prudence.

verses.pali: Hirottappe asati hirottappavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti indriyasaṁvaro.
verses.english: When there is no conscience and prudence, one who lacks conscience and prudence has destroyed a vital condition for sense restraint.

verses.pali: Indriyasaṁvare asati indriyasaṁvaravipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti sīlaṁ.
verses.english: When there is no sense restraint, one who lacks sense restraint has destroyed a vital condition for ethical conduct.

verses.pali: Sīle asati sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi.
verses.english: When there is no ethical conduct, one who lacks ethics has destroyed a vital condition for right immersion.

verses.pali: Sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṁ.
verses.english: When there is no right immersion, one who lacks right immersion has destroyed a vital condition for true knowledge and vision.

verses.pali: Yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo.
verses.english: When there is no true knowledge and vision, one who lacks true knowledge and vision has destroyed a vital condition for disillusionment and dispassion.

verses.pali: Nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṁ.
verses.english: When there is no disillusionment and dispassion, one who lacks disillusionment and dispassion has destroyed a vital condition for knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṁ gacchati, tacopi … pheggupi … sāropi na pāripūriṁ gacchati.
verses.english: Suppose there was a tree that lacked branches and foliage. Its shoots, bark, softwood, and heartwood would not grow to fullness.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, satisampajaññe asati satisampajaññavipannassa hatūpanisaṁ hoti hirottappaṁ;
verses.english: In the same way, when there is no mindfulness and situational awareness, one who lacks mindfulness and situational awareness has destroyed a vital condition for conscience and prudence.

verses.pali: hirottappe asati hirottappavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti …pe…
verses.english: When there is no conscience and prudence …

verses.pali: vimuttiñāṇadassanaṁ.
verses.english: One who lacks disillusionment and dispassion has destroyed a vital condition for knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: Satisampajaññe, bhikkhave, sati satisampajaññasampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti hirottappaṁ.
verses.english: When there is mindfulness and situational awareness, one who has fulfilled mindfulness and situational awareness has fulfilled a vital condition for conscience and prudence.

verses.pali: Hirottappe sati hirottappasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti indriyasaṁvaro.
verses.english: When there is conscience and prudence, one who has fulfilled conscience and prudence has fulfilled a vital condition for sense restraint.

verses.pali: Indriyasaṁvare sati indriyasaṁvarasampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti sīlaṁ.
verses.english: When there is sense restraint, one who has fulfilled sense restraint has fulfilled a vital condition for ethical conduct.

verses.pali: Sīle sati sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi.
verses.english: When there is ethical conduct, one who has fulfilled ethical conduct has fulfilled a vital condition for right immersion.

verses.pali: Sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṁ.
verses.english: When there is right immersion, one who has fulfilled right immersion has fulfilled a vital condition for true knowledge and vision.

verses.pali: Yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo.
verses.english: When there is true knowledge and vision, one who has fulfilled true knowledge and vision has fulfilled a vital condition for disillusionment and dispassion.

verses.pali: Nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṁ.
verses.english: When there is disillusionment and dispassion, one who has fulfilled disillusionment and dispassion has fulfilled a vital condition for knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṁ gacchati, tacopi … pheggupi … sāropi pāripūriṁ gacchati.
verses.english: Suppose there was a tree that was complete with branches and foliage. Its shoots, bark, softwood, and heartwood would grow to fullness.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, satisampajaññe sati satisampajaññasampannassa upanisasampannaṁ hoti hirottappaṁ;
verses.english: In the same way, when there is mindfulness and situational awareness, one who has fulfilled mindfulness and situational awareness has fulfilled a vital condition for conscience and prudence.

verses.pali: hirottappe sati hirottappasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti …pe…
verses.english: When there is conscience and prudence …

verses.pali: vimuttiñāṇadassanan”ti.
verses.english: One who has fulfilled disillusionment and dispassion has fulfilled a vital condition for knowledge and vision of freedom.”

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
